title: Habit Tracker Completion Rate
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:entry
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(completed="true",1,0))) as done, count as scheduled by habit _time
| eval completion_pct=round(100*done/scheduled)
| stats avg(completion_pct) as avg_completion by habit
| sort avg_completion
description: Calculates how consistently you keep each habit and ranks them so you can double down on what is working and rethink what is not.
value: Habits succeed or fail on consistency, not intensity; a completion rate per habit shows exactly where to focus your willpower.
implementation: Export habit-tracker logs to HEC; schedule weekly and review completion rates across habits.
visualization: Bar chart of completion rate by habit.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how well you are sticking to each of your habits, so you can see which ones need more attention.
